## Task 3 – The reproduction

**In your workspace**, in Task 3 of `index.qmd`. Choose one of the three analysts and run the chunk of that analyst line by line: `fit-corrected` for C6HJR, `fit-kqxue` for KQXUE and `fit-018ol` for 018OL. Compare your value with the value on record.

[Open the deck at Task 3](../../live/day.html#/hands-on-3-reproduce-the-recorded-result){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the browser lab at Task 3](../../lab.qmd#task-3-reproduction){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

## Hands-on 3b – Reading deposited code

Open the OSF deposit of the analyst whom you reproduced and find the line that carries the slip. Then write down one check that would have caught it. If you worked in the deck or the browser lab, copy your Task 3 cells and their output into your notes before the break, because a page in the browser forgets everything when it reloads.

[KQXUE, `task2.do`](https://osf.io/vycgd/){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [018OL, the R Markdown file of Task 2](https://osf.io/nz7ka/){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"} [C6HJR, the folder of April 2025](https://osf.io/6zqct/){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}
